items.headline: The CR7 era is over — Ronaldo retires from international football
items.body: After 23 years, a record 234 caps and a record 146 goals, Cristiano Ronaldo has called time on his Portugal career. He walks away as the most-capped and highest-scoring men's international player ever — the end of a genuine era.
items.say: Ronaldo actually retired from international football — 23 years in the Portugal shirt. End of an era, right?

items.headline: Blue bloods, bad night — Michigan State stuns Duke, Kansas routs Kentucky
items.body: College basketball's marquee early showcase delivered in Chicago. No. 5 Michigan State knocked off Duke 79-73 behind Jeremy Fears Jr., while Kansas ran Kentucky off the floor 89-69 with Tre White pouring in 30. Two heavyweight scalps in one night.
items.say: Did you catch the Champions Classic? Michigan State beat Duke and Kansas blew out Kentucky — college hoops is back and it did not ease in.

items.headline: UFC 334 takes over the Garden Saturday — and Harrison vs Nunes is huge
items.body: Madison Square Garden hosts a stacked card Saturday: Ciryl Gane defends the heavyweight title against unbeaten Josh Hokit (10-0), and in the co-main, champ Kayla Harrison meets the returning Amanda Nunes in a blockbuster women's bantamweight showdown.
items.say: There's a big UFC card at the Garden Saturday — Kayla Harrison vs Amanda Nunes is the kind of fight everyone's going to be talking about. You still watch the fights?

items.headline: No rest for CS2 — BLAST Rivals is live in Hong Kong
items.body: The Counter-Strike circuit barely took a breath after IEM Beijing: BLAST Rivals Fall has the world's best teams scrapping in Hong Kong this week, with red-hot Team Spirit among the favorites.
items.say: There's already another big Counter-Strike event on — BLAST Rivals in Hong Kong. The pro scene never sleeps. You play any CS, or watch it?

items.headline: Football's back Thursday — Commanders at Giants kicks off Week 10
items.body: After a quiet couple of days, the NFL returns Thursday night with an NFC East matchup: the Commanders visit the Giants at MetLife Stadium on Prime Video. A division game to get Week 10 rolling.
items.say: NFL's back Thursday night with a Giants–Commanders division game. You riding with anybody this season?

items.headline: Maika Monroe goes full 'Victorian Psycho' — in theaters Friday
items.body: A gothic horror-comedy with a wicked streak: Maika Monroe plays a governess who is very much not what she seems in a blood-soaked 1850s romp that premiered at Cannes. It opens Friday, November 13.
items.say: There's a horror movie out Friday called Victorian Psycho — basically a Victorian lady going full American Psycho. Wild premise, right?

items.headline: ATEEZ keep the hits coming — 'Golden Hour: Part.6' drops Friday
items.body: The K-pop powerhouse returns Friday with a new mini-album led by title track 'UP.' The pre-release single 'Drip' already blew past 8 million YouTube views in two days — the ATINY army is locked in.
items.say: ATEEZ have a new release Friday — their fanbase is massive and the production is wild. You follow any K-pop at all?

items.headline: Snoh Aalegra is back — first album in five years lands Friday
items.body: The silky soul singer returns with 'Legendary Love' on Friday, her first full-length since 2021. The single 'I Love You' even pulls in legends Nile Rodgers and Raphael Saadiq — perfect easy-listening for the weekend.
items.say: Snoh Aalegra has a new album Friday — smooth, soulful stuff, her first in five years. Great rainy-day music. You know her?

items.headline: Grammy season kicks off Monday — 2027 nominations land
items.body: The nominations for the 2027 Grammys drop Monday, November 16, officially starting awards season. The ceremony itself is set for February 7 in Los Angeles. Cue the 'who got snubbed' debates.
items.say: Grammy nominations come out Monday — always fun to argue about who got robbed. Who are you hoping gets a nod this year?
